description: Intellectual property licensing agreements covering patent, copyright, trademark, and trade secret licenses

required_clauses.description: Defines the scope of the license — exclusive or non-exclusive, field of use, territory, and sublicense rights
Specifies who owns background IP, foreground IP, and jointly developed inventions
Defines royalty rates, milestone payments, upfront fees, and payment schedule
Defines who files, maintains, and pays for patents and what happens if one party declines to prosecute
Defines who has the right to sue infringers, who pays for litigation, and how damages are shared
Licensor warrants ownership of IP, no conflicting licenses, and validity of patents
Defines licensee's obligations to develop and commercialize products, including best efforts requirements
Defines agreement duration, termination triggers, notice periods, and post-termination rights
Allocates liability for IP infringement claims, product liability, and breach of warranties
Specifies which jurisdiction's law governs and where disputes are resolved

optional_clauses.description: Right to grant sublicenses to third parties
Licensee grants back improvements to licensor
Guarantees licensee gets best available terms
